edits.new:
Then the stage timer is paused at the return point while the prescription clock keeps running

  Scenario: AC10 Every rule of section 8 has a criterion or a named test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR8 of section 8
    When the rule-to-test mapping of this story is checked before the build
    Then each rule BR1 to BR8 names at least one criterion or test case of this story
    Then the boundary rules BR1 and BR8 are executed by TC-E2-029-14 and TC-E2-029-16 and no rule is left without a test

  Scenario: AC11 An unauthenticated call or an unknown case is refused with 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the owner's session carries no credential
    When a confirmation posts a raise for case "RW-2027-000801" without a credential
    Then the request is refused with status 401 and no deviation row, decision record or outbox row exists
    Given a confirmation names a case identifier that does not exist
    When the raise is posted for that identifier
    Then the request is refused with status 404 and no deviation row, decision record or outbox row exists

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out deviation activity leaves one deviation (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the start of the deviation workflow for the raise of "X1" on case "RW-2027-000801" times out
    When the activity is retried with retry count and timeout Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E2029-APP-AC15)
    Then one deviation exists, one decision record exists and exactly one rwb.deviation.DeviationRaised.v1 outbox row exists
    Then the retry carries the same Idempotency-Key and adds no second deviation, decision record or outbox row
